_notes: Stage 2C (2026-10-21): candlelit.type.headline_case was [caps]; spec 2.3 sets candlelit headings in sentence case (Marcellus >= 36px, Cormorant Garamond 500 >= 32px) with caps only for the name and kickers, so it is now [sentence]. Measured in page context (antialiased, qa.py probe): Marcellus as a caps h1 fails at every size <= 40px (1x 0.26 @40, 2x 0.39 @30), in sentence case it passes at the base floors (56px desktop: 1x 0.12; 48px mobile: 2x 0.20). candlelit-cormorant-sc removed from candlelit.pairings: its sentence h1 face (Cormorant Garamond 500) passes with no margin (1x 0.21 @56, 2x 0.24 @48). candlelit keeps one pairing (inscriptional-marcellus); spec 4.3 wants 2-3, so stage 3 owes a vetted second face.

Stage 2C (2026-10-21): candlelit-forum removed from candlelit.pairings. Forum 400 hairline share (qa.py stroke probe, ink<160, 1 css px opening): 0.35/0.38 at 40px (1x/2x), 0.17/0.26 at 48px, 0.06/0.14 at 56px. The 2x h1 limit is 0.25, so Forum needs >= 56px on phones, above the baseline's 30-44px mobile display range, and candlelit's tracked-caps band tops out at 40px. The probe stays; the pairing goes (contract 3.2). The record stays in pairings.json with dialects [] and a dropped note.

Eight luxury dialects from docs/research/05-luxury-dialects-spec.md (sections 1-4). A dialect is a bounded region of the six-axis personality space plus a curated sub-library. lib/personality.py scores them (photo signals + content vibe + type prior), clamps the axes to the winner, and selects only ids listed here.

Every id carries status: exists (template/data present now), planned-2B (owed by stage 2B, see factory/STAGE-2B-CONTRACT.md) or deferred (named in the spec but not in the phase-2 inventory). Statuses are a snapshot; build.py checks the filesystem (lib/templates.py) and `python3 lib/templates.py --refresh` rewrites them.

Colour values are OKLCH (L 0-1, C, H degrees). Ranges are [min, max]; H is a list of [min, max] ranges. paper.mode = light | dark; paper_dark is an alternate charcoal ground chosen from the photos. contrast_pairs name pairs that must pass 7:1 (lib/palette.py walks them).

rhythm_variants: two section orders per dialect. blocks of kind role resolve to the selected archetype (spaces, story, moment, tour, faq) or the guide; kind section is a stand-alone block resolved via sections/<id>.j2 with the fallbacks below. featured (press names) is inserted after the story when content.featured_in is non-empty; uses closes the page.

fallbacks: nearest existing template per kind, tried in order (ids the dialect allows first). An empty chain means the block is omitted. Every fallback is recorded in build-meta.json fallbacks[] and flagged by qa.py.

dialects.label: Old-world estate
dialects.fits: Stone villas, mansions, castles, mission and hacienda buildings, formal gardens; warm stone, boxwood, terracotta, chandeliers.

photo.hero_bleed: only if lead >= 2400px and shows the building, else inset

dialects.label: Romantic editorial
dialects.fits: Barns and farms that photograph like magazines, garden estates, white houses; soft daylight, florals, film grain, pale sky.
dialects.masthead_rule: masthead only with a muted accent and the dateline replaced by the facts strip

dialects.label: Dark and candlelit
dialects.fits: Historic halls, ballrooms, industrial-heritage hotels, rooftop and dome venues, dusk or candle photography.

photo.scrim: none on dark photos; max 25% black gradient on mid-tone
photo.hero_bleed: full-bleed or inset on charcoal with a brass keyline

rhythm_variants.label: facts strip, spaces, story, optional daylight band
facts strip, story with engraving, then spaces

dialects.label: Modern luxe
dialects.fits: Architect-designed resorts, desert and canyon properties, glass pavilions, minimalist retreats; dusk desert, concrete, water, long shadows.

accent.buttons: outlined or filled in ink, never the accent

photo.hero_bleed: inset with wide margins, or full-bleed landscape with no text

rhythm_variants.label: statement, spaces, moment, tour, story late

motion.device_target: slideshow counter (6s, static under reduced motion)

dialects.corner_rule: the only dialect allowed density >= 85 with voice >= 85, and only with section padding >= 160px and inset photos (exclusion 17)

dialects.label: Coastal and airy
dialects.fits: Ocean-front and lake estates, sailcloth-tent venues, coast inns, white houses near water; bright, blue-white, hydrangea, haze.

paper.note: spec C 0.003-0.008; the shared baseline floor 0.004 wins

photo.scrim: never dark; 20% white gradient from the bottom if text must sit on a photo

rhythm_variants.label: kicker + lyric statement + facts, spaces, story

dialects.label: Botanical garden
dialects.fits: Garden estates, orchid farms, glasshouses, redwood and canyon gardens; green-on-green, dappled light, florals, lavender rows.

photo.hero_bleed: full-bleed only if foliage share >= 0.45 of the lead

rhythm_variants.label: statement with a sprig, spaces as garden bands, story

motion.hover: space bands tint to accent-tint over 400ms

dialects.label: Rustic-refined
dialects.fits: Ranches, vineyards, barns with good bones, canyon and foothill venues; golden grass, oaks, olive, ochre dust, timber.

photo.hero_bleed: landscape full-bleed (golden hour); a barn-interior lead uses frame

dialects.label: Deco glam
dialects.fits: 1920s-40s clubhouses, theatres, period lofts, Palm Springs hotels; monochrome, geometric, brass, lacquer, archival photography.

paper_dark.when: photo mean L < 0.45 or dark share >= 0.45

photo.mono_rule: per photo via content mono: true; never the lead unless the venue site is monochrome

rhythm_variants.label: facts strip with the geometric rule, architect/year story, numbered spaces
